# Third-party notices

This directory preserves upstream license and attribution files for
dependencies identified in the WhyTie v1.1.0 release-candidate binaries,
together with the Go toolchain license.

Dependency directories include their module versions. Upstream files
are copied without modification.

The same notice bundle is included with all platform packages.
Some notices cover components or assets that may not be present in
every binary. Their inclusion does not imply that WhyTie uses every
feature or asset of the upstream project.

These components retain their respective licenses.
WhyTie's Apache-2.0 license does not replace those licenses.
